purpose: Run exactly one bounded current-f01e TP2/PIECEWISE/native-MTP1/F16 exact-4K sentinel against the clean same-image TP2/MTP0 PIECEWISE exact-4K target oracle, with TP2/MTP1 eager exact 4K used only as mechanism evidence. This packet authorizes no other matrix cell, publication, descendant, or replacement.

tp2_mtp0_piecewise_result.scope: Only the clean exact 4K TP2/MTP0 PIECEWISE cell is the target oracle for this sentinel. Its other depths, diagnostic speeds, and publication decisions do not transfer.

same_topology_mtp1_eager_evidence.authority: Mechanism, positive isolated acceptance, target parity, baseline quality, and topology precedent for exact TP2/MTP1 eager F16 4K only; eager speed and every other eager depth do not transfer to PIECEWISE.

exact_depth_contract.candidate_gate: The candidate exact request must pass every depth-helper gate and report cached_tokens=0.
exact_depth_contract.target_gate: All 128 candidate token IDs must exactly equal the clean same-image TP2/MTP0 PIECEWISE 4K target oracle. The pinned TP2/MTP1 eager 4K token array must first equal that target. No other depth or selector is tested or inferred.

quality_contract.gate: Candidate must independently satisfy pass_all, baseline_match_all, seven passing exact cases, eight passing identical repeats with one unique hash, a passing 8K needle, exactly 24 true baseline comparisons, and cached_tokens=0 on all 16 quality requests. The needle is quality-only and creates no exact-8K graph cell.

topology_and_graph_contract.topology: TP2 only on ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0,1; world_size=2/local_world_size=2 plus world ranks and local ranks 0-1 are required. No ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR and no other topology authority are allowed.
topology_and_graph_contract.graph: enforce_eager=False; PIECEWISE size-one capture; mixed prefill-decode PIECEWISE marker and Graph capturing finished required; FULL decode capture forbidden.
topology_and_graph_contract.speculation: Resolved native method mtp, target model path, and num_spec_tokens=1 required. Drafted and accepted counter deltas are isolated around the exact 4K request and must both be positive, finite, and conserved.
topology_and_graph_contract.cache: Fresh dedicated ext4 cache root, prefix cache disabled, exact and every quality request cache-zero, and exactly rank_0_0 and rank_1_0 namespaces required.
topology_and_graph_contract.model: All 19 pinned model files must pass direct and ordinary verification before launch.
topology_and_graph_contract.cleanup: One fresh container/server lifetime, global EXIT/INT/TERM cleanup, container absent, port closed, no EngineCore/vLLM/llama server, and no render users at sealing.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-sentinel: Exact 4K, isolated positive drafting/acceptance, exact TP2/MTP0 PIECEWISE target equality, full objective and baseline quality, TP2 graph/topology/cache/model identity, and cleanup all pass.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: Exact 4K passes but isolated accepted speculation is not proven.
terminal_classification.quarantined-parent-parity-failed: Exact 4K passes but candidate tokens differ from the pinned TP2/MTP0 PIECEWISE target or the pinned TP2/MTP1 eager mechanism evidence no longer equals that target.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: Exact 4K and mechanism/parity gates pass but the explicit full quality audit fails.
terminal_classification.quarantined-exact-depth-failed: The exact 4K request fails; retain only diagnostic evidence.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an exact-image log line explicitly classifying native MTP/speculation as unsupported.
terminal_classification.failed: Startup, identity, graph, topology, endpoint, model, rank cache, cleanup, or another non-explicit failure.

interpretation.pass_authority: A pass establishes only this exact current-f01e TP2/PIECEWISE/native-MTP1/F16/4K internal cell pending separate validation and human publication.

coverage_contract.note: The family contract is intentionally not edited by this preregistration. A later validated publication may add exactly this selector.
